prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: and  conspired against me to change my aisle seat to a middle seat https://t.co/3yhR7Tq2rZ
Delta: Hi, John. I will be happy to assist with your seat selection. Please share your confirmation number via DM for review.  *AJZ https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: This is why I NEVER want anything other than a window seat. ✈️DL0046, #GrandBahama 🐟. Please , no thanks for your best aisle seats. https://t.co/vzJkrUg2uQ
Delta: You captured that perfectly! 😍 *ATJ

Customer: why upgrade a platinum medallion to Delta Comfort but to a middle seat and leave 2 open seats in aisle/window for Stand-Byers? + I️ wasn’t given an option to switch seats #notcool DL2793
Delta: I'm sorry about this. Right now, our system doesn't have the ability to filter out center seats when upgrading to Comfort+. I don't see any windows or aisles left on your flight, but perhaps the gate can rearrange things. *HWG

Customer: THANK YOU  for changing my seat from an aisle exit row to bulk head window then finally to a middle seat for my 4 hour flight, all while on my connector 🖕
Delta: I am truly sorry about the seating issues, Christopher. Would you like me to look for an alternate seat for you? *TJF

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: service_complaint):
"""need to rant! First/Business Class > Comfort+ (Aisle/Window) > Economy (Aisle/Window) > ANY MIDDLE SEAT! Add a feature to exclude middle seats on upgrades—NO ONE WANTS THEM! Thanks"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We hear you—middle seats aren’t ideal for upgrades. Our system currently can’t filter them out, but we’ll pass this feedback along. If you’d like help with a specific reservation, please DM us your confirmation number.
